title: Abba of Sura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as the father-in-law of Rav Papa and of Rav Papa’s son Abba, both of whom married his daughters, citing [Ketubot 39b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.39b.3) and [52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.52b.18) and [Sanhedrin 14b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.14b.9).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Ketubot has Rav Papa quoting Abba of Sura’s daughter and describes Rav Papa arranging his son’s marriage into Abba of Sura’s household.
Sanhedrin names Rav Papa and the daughter of Abba of Sura. The identification of Rav Papa’s son as Abba is Hyman’s.
